answer: One identity, one marble beacon post. Each applicant locks a 70-credit bond for one vertex; no two posts share a vertex, and each marble grain is recorded. Each epoch the post must emit a fresh pulse reading with a new serial; auditors check all three against the pulse table. A missed epoch dims the beacon 10%; a reused serial burns the bond. First fake 36, kth 36+7(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,532,500 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 36 once.
